title: Banks cannot blacklist advocates by putting them on caution list: Supreme Court
description: The Supreme Court on Tuesday held that banks cannot effectively blacklist advocates across the banking sector by placing their names on the Indian Banks’ Association’s (IBA) caution list merely on allegations of negligence or an erroneous legal opinion [Ajay Vijh v. Indian Banks Association & Ors.].
